summary: Describes a base solution and an experimental protocol to support mobile multicast senders in Proxy Mobile IPv6 domains. It defines optimizations such as synchronizing PMIPv6 with PIM and a peering function for MLD proxies, while the mobile sources remain unaware.

eli5.summary: A moving device wants to send a message to a whole group as it travels. This lets the network handle the hard parts so the device never has to notice.

questions: multicast sender in proxy mobile ipv6
